messages.subject: Project Willow - AAA mark-up (Bank's comments)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the amendment and restatement attached. Principal changes: margin to 5.75%, amendment fee to £200,000, opening leverage covenant to 4.50x, DSCR to 1.15x, and equity cures limited to two. Most other points are tidy-ups. Happy to take a call once you've reviewed.

Dominic Pendle
Partner | Pendle Voss LLP
